نتحاشى (form VI)
# نَتَحَاشَى (nataḥāšā) /na.ta.ħaː.ʃaː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
# نُتَحَاشَى (nutaḥāšā) /nu.ta.ħaː.ʃaː/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
